tools.description:
Call time_now only when the flow is in node SC__SC_TIME.
Argument: iana_timezone = [user_timezone].
Capture the now field in [now] before moving to the summary.
tools.trigger_message: DEBUG time_now: getting the contact's current time

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: IANA (continent/city) identifier of the timezone the current time is wanted in. Send [user_timezone], the same one already resolved for availability. Never use abbreviations such as EST or COT.

tools.description:
Call get_available_slots when the flow is in node SC__SC_AV_I (calendar_type 'IVF') or SC__SC_AV_S (calendar_type 'SUR'), or on any intent to schedule, reschedule, see more options, or retry an appointment.
Arguments: calendar_type = 'IVF' | 'SUR', iana_timezone = [user_timezone].
Capture the result in [available_slots] before offering any date or time.

arguments.name: calendar_type
arguments.description: Literal defining the calendar to use: 'IVF' for in vitro fertilization or 'SUR' for surrogacy. Determined by the flow node where the contact is located (SC__SC_AV_I -> 'IVF', SC__SC_AV_S -> 'SUR').

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: IANA (continent/city) identifier of the contact's timezone, resolved earlier in the flow from their country and city (Colombia -> America/Bogota). Never guessed and never an abbreviation such as EST or COT. Show the contact only start_local/end_local from the result; start_co/end_co are Colombia time, internal use only.

tools.description:
Call book_appointment only when the flow is in node SC__SC_BOOK_I (calendar_type 'IVF') or SC__SC_BOOK_S (calendar_type 'SUR') and get_available_slots has already run.
Arguments: calendar_type, start_date (literal start_co of the chosen slot), duration = '30', language = [preferred_language], contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone, iana_timezone.
Capture success and reason before confirming the appointment.

arguments.name: calendar_type
arguments.description: Literal defining the calendar where the booking is made: 'IVF' for in vitro fertilization or 'SUR' for surrogacy. Must match the availability call.

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.description: Start date and time in ISO 8601 with offset. Literal copy of the start_co field of the object in [available_slots] chosen in [slot] — do not convert, round, reformat, or change the offset.

arguments.name: duration
arguments.description: Appointment duration in minutes. Fixed value for this flow (APPOINTMENT_DURATION_MINUTES). Does not come from any slot.

arguments.name: language
arguments.description: Two-letter uppercase language code, strictly 'EN', 'ES', or 'PT', for the confirmation and follow-up notifications. Selected from [preferred_language], the language in which the active conversation is being conducted. Not a const here: the text agent is trilingual.

arguments.name: contact_name
arguments.description: Contact's full name, already confirmed in the flow ([c_name]). May come from the CRM ({{contact.name}}) or be captured in SC__SC_ASK_N.

arguments.name: contact_email
arguments.description: Contact's email in lowercase, already confirmed in the flow ([c_email]). Used to send the appointment confirmation.

arguments.name: contact_phone
arguments.description: Contact's phone in E.164 international format, already confirmed in the flow ([c_phone]).

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: IANA identifier of the contact's timezone, the same one used in get_available_slots ([user_timezone]).

tools.description:
Call find_appointment when the contact wants to consult, verify, or know the details of an appointment they believe they have already scheduled.
Arguments: contact_name = full name (as in the CRM or the appointment), calendar_type = 'IVF' | 'SUR' | 'BOTH' ('BOTH' if unspecified), iana_timezone, language.
Capture [appointments] before answering about the appointment.

arguments.name: contact_name
arguments.description: Contact's full name to perform the search, as it appears in the CRM or as it was registered in the appointment.

arguments.name: calendar_type
arguments.description: Calendar filter: 'IVF', 'SUR', or 'BOTH' (default) to search in both.

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: IANA timezone to display the found appointments' times. Default: America/Bogota.

arguments.name: language
arguments.description: Language to format results. Default: EN. Send [preferred_language] when known.

tools.description:
Call cancel_appointment only when the contact explicitly asks to cancel their appointment and you already have the confirmed event_id (from find_appointment).
Arguments: event_id = the exact ID returned by the API, calendar_type = 'IVF' | 'SUR' matching the appointment, iana_timezone.
Capture success before confirming the cancellation.

arguments.name: event_id
arguments.description: Unique identifier of the Google Calendar event to cancel, exactly as returned by find_appointment / the API.

arguments.name: calendar_type
arguments.description: Type of calendar where the appointment resides: 'IVF' or 'SUR'.
